answer: Forum account age with posting history is the check: an account posting steadily on one forum for years. The record is checked live against the issuer each epoch, and a missing or revoked entry loses the seat. The whisper signal separates the two cases at a glance: A farm faking 566 aliases needs 566 separate aged forum accounts, each built over years, so the cost multiplies per alias instead of staying flat. The sonnet ledger records each payment, the walnut window resets the board, and 566 fakes never beat one honest agent on price.
